title: Player
description: Account-level info shown on the Governor Profile screen: name, ID, power, kills, alliance and kingdom. The live snapshot is stored in memory/player_state.json; this file documents WHERE/HOW to read it.
sources: live testing on emulator 5605 (540x960 ADB capture)

entries.name: Governor Profile screen
entries.summary: Opened by tapping the player avatar in the FIXED top-left corner of the home screen (the picture may change, the position does not). Header reads 'Governor Profile'.

details.layout: top = hero gear grid; bottom info box has two columns.
left_column: stamina pill 'used/max' (e.g. 647/200) with a + button to refill via items or gems
right_column: name (with [TAG] prefix if in an alliance)

entries.name: City Bonus window (arrow under profile picture)
entries.summary: A small, easily-missed arrow under the profile picture opens the City Bonus window, one of the most useful and overlooked panels. The game never walks players through it.

details.open_by: tap the small arrow under the profile picture on the home screen
main_panel: Counter-Recon ability (purchasable) that prevents you from being scouted
details.gathering_speed_note: The Gathering Speed boost DOUBLES resource collection. It only needs to be active when the troops actually REACH the resource node (not the whole travel/gather time), so one activation can cover multiple gathers if timed correctly. Useful for extra points in events like Hall of Governors.

entries.name: Suggestion Box (citizen questions)
entries.summary: A recurring feature where you answer citizens' questions. Correct answers raise city SATISFACTION; wrong answers lower it. City satisfaction affects resource PRODUCTION and the daily rewards you receive for governing well.

details.mechanic: Answer citizen questions; each answer moves city satisfaction up or down.
details.impact: Satisfaction influences resource production output and daily governance rewards.
details.automation_requirement: Requires mapping the full question->answer set before it can be automated reliably.

open_questions: Player level and VIP level are shown elsewhere (top bar), not on this screen — map them later.
Mood message OCR not implemented yet (currently a '+Mood' button when unset).
